news_items.headline: Symbotic shares fall ~8% on insider stock sales by executives
news_items.summary: SYM dropped roughly 8% after disclosures of insider stock sales by company executives, raising questions about confidence in the backlog growth story.

news_items.headline: Symbotic falls ~8.4% on competitive-position concerns versus Serve Robotics
news_items.summary: Shares declined about 8.4% on worries about Symbotic's competitive positioning against Serve Robotics, even as the broader market rose and despite recent positive revenue growth.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus is split across sources (Buy/Moderate Buy on some, Hold on others; one tally shows 7 Buy / 10 Hold / 3 Sell of 21 analysts). Average PT ~$67.63 (high $80, low $44). No clearly dated upgrades/downgrades within the last 7 days; ratings reflect post-Q2 (May 6) digestion.

earnings_context.notes: Last earnings Q2 FY2026 reported ~2026-05-06 (older than 7-day window, already priced in): revenue $676.48M (+23% YoY) beat consensus $662.65M, net income ~$9M, first GAAP profitability, backlog ~$22.4-22.7B. Q3 2026 guidance $700M-$720M. Street focus: converting record backlog into profitable, scalable deployments amid next-gen storage transition and high customer concentration risks.
